scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns only the centered normalized radial power in Braun's slow-diffusion parameter regime. It does not identify the full self-similar vector process, does not treat uncentered or fast-diffusion cases, and makes no claim beyond the exact Jacobi reduction and its consequences. The proof is analytic; no finite experiment is used as evidence. A residual literature risk remains for an equivalent classical diffusion transformation under different terminology.
title: A hidden Jacobi diffusion in centered Leibenson radial dynamics
